summary: Serves as the root infrastructure and domain package, organizing modular subcomponents for database persistence, filesystem operations, CSV processing, archive management, configuration, logging, core business services, and system utilities.
responsibilities: Manage ZIP archives and metadata entries
Parse and serialize CSV data using Pydantic models
Handle database connections, ORM models, repositories, and transactions via SQLAlchemy
Provide filesystem I/O, search, and operation helper utilities
Perform core domain services including business calendars, parameter access, and variable translation
Compute cryptographic hashes for strings, bytes, and files
Provide application-wide logging facilities and factories
Execute system processes and manage execution results and errors
Provide lazy stream processing and byte stream I/O utilities
relationships: The package groups various independent infrastructure utilities and domain services under a unified root package namespace.
design_decisions: Modularizes infrastructure and domain components into cohesive subdirectories covering data persistence, file handling, configuration, logging, and core business logic services.
